title: 一个小插头，凭什么烧掉显卡？
title_en: How Does One Little Plug Burn a Graphics Card?

segments.zh: 两天，七张显卡送进维修店，
segments.en: Two days, seven graphics cards at one repair shop,
every power plug burned.

segments.zh: 每一张都是上万块的高端卡，
segments.en: Each one a top-end card worth thousands,

segments.zh: 烧的却是一个小小的插头。
segments.en: and what burned was a tiny plug.

segments.zh: 今天的问题：一个小插头，
segments.en: Today's question: how does one little plug
take down a whole graphics card?
Meet Xiaoka.

segments.zh: 小卡是一张显卡，胃口特别大。
segments.en: Xiaoka is a graphics card with a huge appetite.
At full load, an RTX 5090
eats 575 watts.

segments.zh: 可显卡只吃12伏的低压电。
segments.en: But it only eats 12-volt power.
Low voltage means high current.
575 divided by 12
is about 48 amps.

segments.zh: 家里两千瓦的电水壶，也就九安左右。
segments.en: A 2,000-watt kettle at home draws about 9 amps.
Xiaoka wants over five times that.

segments.zh: 这48安，全从一个插头过去，
segments.en: All 48 amps squeeze through one plug,

segments.zh: 插头里只有六根细细的针。
segments.en: through just six thin pins.
On average,
each pin carries 8 amps.
The spec says each pin can handle
about 9.2 amps at most.
Twist one: do the math,
the safety margin is only about 15 percent.

segments.zh: 据估算，老式8针插头的余量
segments.en: By common estimates, the old 8-pin plug
had nearly double.
But 8 amps is under the limit.
So why does it burn?
Picture six people
carrying one piano.
If two of them loosen their grip,

segments.zh: 重量就全压到别人身上。
segments.en: the weight lands on everyone else.

segments.zh: 电流也一样：六根针并排走，
segments.en: Current is the same: six pins side by side,

segments.zh: 哪根接触好，电就往哪根挤。
segments.en: and it crowds into whichever pin touches best.

segments.zh: 插头没插到底、针脚松一点，
segments.en: A plug not pushed all the way in, a loose pin,
and the contact gets worse.
Twist two: when reviewers measured it,
some wires carried almost nothing.
And one wire
carried 22 amps!
That's more than double
the spec limit.

segments.zh: 反转三，最反直觉：电流翻一倍，
segments.en: Twist three, the weird part: double the current,
and you get four times the heat.

segments.zh: 因为发热等于电流的平方
segments.en: Because heat equals current squared
times resistance.
22 amps is less than three times 8,
but the heat is over seven times.

segments.zh: 更糟的是：热了，接触更差；
segments.en: Worse: heat makes the contact worse,
and worse contact makes more heat.
Round and round it climbs,
like a snowball rolling downhill.
The thermal camera says
the plug hit 175 degrees Celsius.
The plastic melts,
and cable and plug fuse into one lump.
How to prevent it? First, push it all the way in
until it clicks.
Second, don't bend the cable sharply
right at the plug.

segments.zh: 第三，有的高端卡会逐根测电流，
segments.en: Third, some high-end cards measure each wire
and warn you when they're uneven.

segments.zh: 友情提示：每张卡到底为什么烧，
segments.en: Friendly fine print: why each card burned
hasn't been settled by the makers.

segments.zh: 我们讲的只是物理：余量小、电流不均，
segments.en: This is just the physics: thin margins, uneven current,
and heat that grows with the square.
Xiaoka's new year's wish:
eat a little less, and keep cool.

elements.text: 哪根接触好，电就往哪挤
